pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.e.e1: {b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} For weeks we have been talking past each other, and I see little movement. Is there still any interest in an extension?
{b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} Frankly, so far it sounds more like a farewell than a future. Do you really want to keep {name}?
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.e.e2: {b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} We are not far apart. Let us set the framework and wrap this up quickly.
{b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} I sense goodwill on both sides. Only the timetable and details are missing, then it can be signed.
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.e.e3: {b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} The tone is getting rougher, and that helps nobody. Can we start over and talk about the extension objectively?
{b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} I notice the mood is tense. I do not want this to turn into a quarrel over the contract.
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.e.e4: {b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} I will not let my client be treated like this! Either you put a serious offer on the table, or we talk to others!
{b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} He is furious, and I can hardly hold him back. Where is an offer worthy of the name?
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.e.e5: {b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} My client wants to stay, and it should go calmly and fairly. I see no reason for haste, but for a clear plan.
{b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} He is attached to the club. So I only ask for an honest offer, without tactics.
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.e.e6: {b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} He only signs if the club has sporting plans. Show me what role he plays in your project.

pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.e.e7: {b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} The contract is running out, and I would like to know soon where we stand. How do you picture the coming weeks?
{b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} It is time for a first concrete talk about the extension. What can I tell my client?
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.e.e8: {b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} Last time something was held out to us, and nothing happened. Before we go on, I need commitment.
{b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} There were promises that were not kept. I have no explanation left for my client.
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.e.e9: {b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} He doubts whether he is wanted here, and other clubs show interest. A clear sign from you would move a lot.
{b.verhandlung_verlaengerung_lage} Interested parties are coming forward in the background, and my client needs to feel needed here. How serious are you?
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.a.a1: I offer an extension, and a binding one. Within {frist} days you will have my written proposal.

pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.a.a2: We find a middle way: a somewhat longer term, moderate on the fixed salary, with bonuses for appearances and titles.

pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.a.a3: Let me explain the framework: the salary structure, the planning for the coming years and the place he has in it. Then you will see I mean it.

pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.a.a4: I know he needs appreciation, and he has earned it. Tell him he is one of my cornerstones.
He matters to me as a person and as a player. He should hear that from me before any figures are named.
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.a.a5: What exactly does he need to stay: more money, a longer term or more security?
Before I answer, tell me what the extension depends on for him.
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.a.a6: I will ask the sporting director to go through the key figures with you. Afterwards the three of us sit down together.
The sporting director will settle the figures with you. I join when it comes to signing.
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.a.a7: It will come, please be a little patient. We have a lot on the table right now.
Let us discuss it after the international break, right now it is inconvenient.
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.a.a8: There will be no extension on these terms. If your client does not accept that, he had better look elsewhere.
With this demand there is no point in negotiating. For me this conversation is over.
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.a.a9: My offer stays as it is. I do not negotiate with pressure at my back, not even from other clubs.
Enquiries from outside change nothing. Whoever wants to stay here takes this offer.
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.a.a10: The club plans over years, not weeks. I cannot promise a deal on your timetable.
I tell you openly: I decide when the squad allows it, not when the agent pushes.
pool.verhandlung_verlaengerung.a.a11: On signing there is a handshake bonus, a small reward for steady nerves. In return your phone will be quieter at night.
If he signs, I add a loyalty bonus, so that you have something to celebrate too.

{b.schlecht} That will disappoint him, and me as well.

{b.schlecht} I understand and will now examine my client's options more widely.

{b.schlecht} I had hoped for more accommodation, especially from you.

pool.verhandlung_gehalt.a.a11: On top of the salary comes a performance bonus for each game we win. That way we both gain when it goes well.

pool.verhandlung_gehalt.a.a12: We have talked for a long time, and I respect your work. So I say openly what is possible and come a little further to meet you.

pool.verhandlung_klausel.e.e5: {b.verhandlung_klausel_lage} My client feels at home, and yet a clause is customary these days. It is about trust on both sides.
{b.verhandlung_klausel_lage} We do not want the clause in order to leave but to stay safely. I am glad to explain.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.e.e6: {b.verhandlung_klausel_lage} He wants to secure the option of a bigger club, and that needs a fixed sum in the contract. Show me you will not block it for him.
{b.verhandlung_klausel_lage} For his career a clause is the minimum. How far do you go?
pool.verhandlung_klausel.e.e7: {b.verhandlung_klausel_lage} A clause belongs with a player of his quality. I would like to hear where you stand on sum and timing.
{b.verhandlung_klausel_lage} We are talking about a possible fee in the contract. What ideas does the club have?
pool.verhandlung_klausel.e.e8: {b.verhandlung_klausel_lage} You held out a clause that never appeared on paper. I no longer accept promises, only text.
{b.verhandlung_klausel_lage} Promises about the clause were not kept. I now insist on binding wording.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.e.e9: {b.verhandlung_klausel_lage} My client has interested parties behind him, and with a clause he would keep all paths open. Without it he feels trapped.
{b.verhandlung_klausel_lage} He feels cramped if he does not know whether he may leave. A clause would free him.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a1: I promise the clause. We decide the fee and the timing together, and within {frist} days the wording will be ready.
Your client gets the clause. We will record the key points in writing within {frist} days.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a2: Then I set it higher and postpone the start, so the club stays protected, and your client still has his way out.
The clause applies only after the first season, in return I leave room on the sum.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a3: Let me explain why a low clause is dangerous: it attracts buyers and devalues the contract for both sides.
A clause is a price tag, and one set too low lures buyers. Let me show the consequences.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a4: I understand that he does not want to feel locked in. I take that seriously, and I want him to decide freely here.
Nobody should feel trapped. I will look with you for a way that gives him peace.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a5: What order of magnitude do you imagine for the fee, and from when should it apply?
Who is to hold the right of first refusal in a sale, your client or the club?
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a6: The managing director will check the clause with the legal department. I will come back to you with the result.
The board calculates the sum, not me. I ask for a little time.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a7: I cannot say anything about that today, but I promise to take it along. Let us finish the season first.
A clause is not on my list, but I will think about it. Give me time.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a8: A release clause is out of the question for me. Whoever signs here stays here.
With a clause the contract would not be worth the paper. I refuse.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a9: I stay with my no. Contracts are honoured, and whoever demands a back door is already planning his farewell.
Pressure will not shake that. No clause, that is how it stands.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a10: The right of first refusal in the club's favour and a clear time limit are mandatory for me, otherwise no clause. That is my framework.
The clause is only conceivable with conditions that protect the club. I do not negotiate that.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a11: Instead of a clause I offer a loyalty bonus: whoever stays is rewarded. That is safer for your client and sounder for us.
A bonus for every year at the club instead of a clause, that is my offer, and it has weight.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.a.a12: We have known each other long, and I am no friend of back doors. But I see your argument and am ready to move if you do too.
Because you have always been honest, I speak openly: the clause is not ruled out, we only have to find the details.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r1: {b.gut} With that my client has his way out and still the club behind him. I thank you.
{b.gut} That is a fair gesture. I will pass it on immediately.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r2: {b.gut} That is how to close a contract both can live with.
{b.gut} That is a sensible framework. We will get it in order.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r3: {b.gut} With a firm clause he can concentrate calmly on the game, that is an incentive for him.
{b.gut} A clear path upward, that mattered to him. He will be grateful.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r4: {b.gut} That you take away his fear of being locked in does him good. Thanks.
{b.gut} He did not expect so much understanding. That calms him.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r5: {b.neutral} I must discuss with my client whether that is enough. I promise nothing today.
{b.neutral} That is neither yes nor no. I will be in touch in the next few days.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r6: {b.neutral} I do not know how he will take it. He is a different man every day.
{b.neutral} My client is hard to read today. I will ask once things have settled.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r7: {b.neutral} The clause remains open, both sides still have room. We only have to find the timing.
{b.neutral} We do not agree on the principle and yet are not far apart.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r8: {b.neutral} I will let that stand, then we talk later. It is not urgent.
{b.neutral} Fine, we let the topic rest and take it up again.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r9: {b.schlecht} Without a clause he does not sign, and I will tell him exactly that.
{b.schlecht} That leaves no basis. I am very disappointed.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r10: {b.schlecht} Then we will listen to other clubs, and you will hear nothing more from us!
{b.schlecht} Back door or nothing, and you have decided! That is your loss!
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r11: {b.schlecht} Then I will examine the alternatives. Thank you for your candour, it helps me plan.
{b.schlecht} If no option remains here, I will speak to the interested parties.
pool.verhandlung_klausel.r.r12: {b.schlecht} He wanted to trust you, but this no hurts him. I had expected more.
{b.schlecht} I would have thought you would understand him better. He will not forget it.
